Food that made my heart happy!
Aug 2025 • Family
We are a family on holiday in Vietnam. Being Sardinian, I was feeling a little homesick and decided to try this restaurant. I could not have made a better choice. From the minute we walked through the door, I was home again. The decor, the atmosphere, the warm welcome, could not have been better. This was without even tasting the food. Our meals were absolutely delicious - the tomato sauce was reminiscent of my grandmother’s, and brought tears to my eyes. The attention to detail (the pasta is made freshly every day) and the careful sourcing of Italian ingredients, make this a gem that should not be missed. I cannot recommend this restaurant enough to anyone wanting to taste authentic, delicious Italian and Sardinian food. Wonderful.

Food great..
Jan 2025 • Couples
Walked by this quaint place, looked welcoming and menu appetising so suggested to hubby to come back the next day. Run by a Sardinians Sis&Bro team - sister, who is the chef and brother, who is front of house. Food was great, we'd would definitely recommend! 

What would push it to 5 stars? Personally if the brother wasn't so damn RUDE. From a service industry background, you'd acknowledge both of your customers however throughout the whole dinner experience, he ONLY acknowledged my husband. (great for the hubby, but he noticed as well) That was quite unpleasant. And no, the guy's not gay. I compare it to many places we've enjoyed, pleasant experiences and conversations, even the local restaurants have frontline staff addressing BOTH patrons with much more better manners.
